signals_info.description: Whether the AEB braking request is active.

nl_Literal_translation_en: At some time between 0.2 and 0.5 seconds from now, the AEB braking request shall be active.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 从现在起第 0.2 秒到第 0.5 秒之间，AEB 制动请求应至少有一个时刻处于生效状态。
nl_Paraphrase_en: The AEB braking request shall be active at least once during the response window from 0.2 to 0.5 seconds.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: AEB 制动请求应在第 0.2 秒至第 0.5 秒的响应窗口内至少生效一次。
